advice-792b57b21911713633a1a870.title: Selectivity of spiritual union
advice-792b57b21911713633a1a870.body: Most people waste their inner fire on random connections, obeying biological rattling. A conscious person understands: union is “birth in beauty.” Every merger should be an act of creation, not consumption. If the partner does not resonate with your Logos, such a connection defiles your “leading principle”. Choose those who enhance your “tonic density”, turning passion into a tool of power over fate. Female slaves, with whom the human masses are now filled, cannot give true love to a person. Even hetaeras are higher than 99% of owner-consumers from the consumer society. Therefore, at the present time, finding a worthy passion for a man who has gained will, strength, intelligence and power is extremely difficult. Slaves are only worthy of slaves. Anyone who has freed himself will inevitably face the problem of loneliness until he finds his chosen one. But this may not happen very soon, be prepared for this.

advice-7e8b42a5828bff94a4e8e273.title: Purification of the sexual impulse
advice-7e8b42a5828bff94a4e8e273.body: Treat intimacy with your chosen one as a theurgic operation. As the ancient priests taught, through the correct connection of principles, the masculine receives strength, and the feminine receives form. Your task is to see in your partner not an “object”, but a “living Eidos”. At the moment of highest tension, the mind must remain awake, transferring energy from the area of sensations to the area of intelligible light. This allows the physical act to be transformed into a ritual of “rebirth”, where two become “one and whole”, imitating the unity of the Mind.

advice-c931141d946cfff1dbcd1aac.title: Freedom from Emotional Noise
advice-c931141d946cfff1dbcd1aac.body: The love of the profane is full of complaints, grievances and need. For a conscious person, Eros is a “dry soul”, devoid of sticky sentimentality. Plotinus pointed out that “the true object of our love is There.” In earthly relationships you should not seek “support”, but a joint ascension. Eliminate from your relationships everything that smacks of “need” (Penya) and act from a position of “excess” (Poros). Only the union of two self-sufficient worlds creates an indestructible empire.

advice-7889448a58ccadda248cdaf5.title: Fixing the Divine Imprint
advice-7889448a58ccadda248cdaf5.body: After the act of merging, the conscious person does not fall into oblivion or relaxation. On the contrary, this is the moment of maximum concentration. The energy raised by Eros should be aimed at strengthening your business, home and family. Consider the fruits of your union - be it thoughts, projects or children - as the materialization of that “nectar” with which Poros was intoxicated in the garden of Zeus. Your sexuality is your personal demiurgic compass, outlining the boundaries of your influence.

advice-5513a78fc93ff124fab4739a.title: Rigorous Choice of a Partner
advice-5513a78fc93ff124fab4739a.body: Your body and your “smart fire” are too precious to be mixed with just anyone. Remember that through the act "a woman receives the power of a man." If your partner is devoid of Logos and structure, you voluntarily give up your resource to Chaos. Connecting with a layman is a “miasma” that will poison your business and mind for a long time after physical contact. Look for someone whose “eidos” is worthy of your complicity.

advice-d48d39456e2e1ace76dec126.title: Guarding Inner Silence
advice-d48d39456e2e1ace76dec126.body: In the process of getting closer, do not allow your mind to drown in the “muddy vapor” of emotions. Plotinus taught that the contemplator must “abide in silence beyond all things.” Even at the moment of greatest physical stress, maintain a point of stillness within. Watch the process. This will allow you not to “drain” energy into emptiness, but to fix it within the system for subsequent achievements in business or creativity.

advice-c7fbf6923413f6a60aeebe33.title: The semantic content of intimacy
advice-c7fbf6923413f6a60aeebe33.body: Stop perceiving sex as a "rest from work." This is the most important thing. And in nature, for living beings this is the final goal of their existence. Having multiplied means you have achieved success. This is the basic animal level, but there is something higher. At the moment of intercourse, you literally reassemble the world. Use the tension of passion as energy to visualize your celebration, which will fuel you later in the day, fueling your passion in realizing your global goals. By connecting with a partner, you connect possibility with form. Let every movement be a conscious act of affirmation of your Divine Will.

advice-27d7fa73b5811e66b00c0514.title: The mystery of silence after intimacy
advice-27d7fa73b5811e66b00c0514.body: After completing the act, do not rush to return to profane conversations or, God forbid, to social networks. Keep the “seal of silence.” The ancient sages knew that “ignorance of the worthy is darkness,” and knowledge requires concealment. Remain in the state of “both are one” for as long as possible, absorbing the strength received. This is the time of incubation of meanings, when your Nus is most permeable to higher strategies.

advice-18d25a5cc19b1fcd98af8266.title: Eliminating ghost images
advice-18d25a5cc19b1fcd98af8266.body: Any fantasies and pornographic “pictures in the soul,” as well as viewing pornographic materials, are false writings that, according to Plato, are painted within us by a “bad painter.” A conscious person purifies his imagination, realizing that "to enjoy anything" means to desecrate the sanctuary of his mind. Every time you replace reality with an imaginary scenario, you inflict “scars and wounds” on your soul that make it crooked and ugly.

advice-87cbacb7c6a0649349c83164.title: Refusal of a sexual surrogate
advice-87cbacb7c6a0649349c83164.body: The use of technical means and toys turns a sacred act into a “chef’s servility,” which only pretends to be good, but in fact destroys the health of the soul. Remember the words of Marcus Aurelius: “during copulation there is friction of the viscera and secretion of mucus.” If there is no spark of Logos and the connection of living monads in this, you are only enslaving in lower aspirations, becoming like a puppet. True strength is born only in resonance with another living Mind.

advice-54375e6f4fb85cde880d6622.title: Maintaining distance from extremes
advice-54375e6f4fb85cde880d6622.body: Any perversions and extremes are “the frenzy of the foolish.” A conscientious person adheres to the saying “Nothing in excess.” Excessive pleasure, like excessive pain, “nails the soul to the body,” forcing it to believe that these shadows are the true reality. Your task is to maintain a “dry soul” that allows you to see through things without falling for the bait of a biological spasm.

advice-9db0dcdf4796d1485c9ea8b5.title: Guarding the Identity Threshold
advice-9db0dcdf4796d1485c9ea8b5.body: Don't let random impulses erode your inner structure. Anyone who follows the “vulgar Eros” quickly loses stability, since he “becomes attached to the fickle.” Be true to your demiurgic function. A man must carry strength, a woman must carry form. Any union that violates this cosmic geometry for the sake of “a momentary enjoyment of anything” turns your personal Cosmos into a “shapeless swamp.”

advice-5fe8038256c475e11f27ecd4.title: The Multiplier of Intellectual Presence
advice-5fe8038256c475e11f27ecd4.body: In the current demographic and semantic vacuum, one bearer of the sovereign Nous (Mind) is obliged to inseminate as much space as possible in reality. Monogamy often becomes a bottleneck that limits the broadcast of your Eidos. Expanding your circle of wives allows your Logos to incarnate in many branches, turning your home into a shining Acropolis, protected from entropy.

advice-b212191995ac28a7f7d41d62.title: Unity of the Women's Circle
advice-b212191995ac28a7f7d41d62.body: The openness of women to union with each other, based on their “natural affinity”, which Plato spoke of, is the key to the strength of the structure. When the women of the clan form a “choir” similar to the choir of the Muses, they create an environment of absolute aesthetic and emotional density inside the house. This is not competition for the leader’s attention, but a joint “weaving of threads” of a common destiny, where the spouses’ attraction to each other only strengthens the unity of the entire system.

advice-52fb3d1300a87a8497f51bef.title: Overcoming a culture of shame
advice-52fb3d1300a87a8497f51bef.body: Modern restrictions on the number of unions are a consequence of the “culture of guilt and shame” described by scholars of antiquity as a degradation of true dignity. A conscious person stands above the “opinions of the crowd”, focusing on divine models. If your nature requires a “royal weaving” from many destinies to save the race from oblivion, then any adherence to imposed dogmas is an act of self-betrayal.

advice-8d86b4d100c61bd2392868ec.title: The aesthetics of collective flourishing
advice-8d86b4d100c61bd2392868ec.body: A multiple union allows each participant to express her unique “eidos” within the framework of a single harmony. Just as Zeus, through various unions, gave birth to the Muses, and Charit, and Athena, so your clan, through the diversity of feminine principles, gives birth to a multifaceted and invincible reality. This transforms sexuality from private consumption into a great “liturgy of exchange”, where each new participant is a new degree of freedom and power for your empire.

advice-2d0c7aba0a6831c3ff273028.title: Law of Unity of Form
advice-2d0c7aba0a6831c3ff273028.body: In any creative act there must be one Architect. A conscious person understands: the feminine principle by its nature is a “mirror” reflecting the Logos of the husband. Polyandry creates a situation where they try to simultaneously direct several divergent rays into one mirror, which leads to “intellectual rattling” and the birth of “monsters in the soul.” This is non-biological, as it contradicts the principle of Nous (Mind), which “rules everything, being at peace” and unity. Therefore, polyandry should be condemned, condemned, because it is anti-natural.

advice-2f6975e231a8508a55c608c6.title: Guarding the Seminal Word
advice-2f6975e231a8508a55c608c6.body: A man carries within himself a specific code of his kind. As the Pythagoreans taught, “from good is born good.” Polygamy allows this code to scale, strengthening the clan. On the contrary, polyandry is an act of “ontological betrayal.” If a woman mixes the influences of different men, she ceases to be a “sacred vessel” of one kind and becomes a conductor of Chaos. For your empire, this means a loss of controllability: you will not be able to pass on your meanings to your heirs, since their “leading principle” will be poisoned by alien inclusions.

advice-91a768be6ab97049822a08ac.title: Charter of Loyalty to the Source
advice-91a768be6ab97049822a08ac.body: The freedom of a conscious person lies in the right to identity. Polyandry erodes this identity into "dirty sludge." Plotinus pointed out that the soul becomes evil when it “comes out of itself into distraction.” A woman, who belongs to many, loses her “spherical roundness” and the ability to be a “mother-nurse” for the one Logos. This is a form of perversion, since it replaces the creation of the Cosmos with the mechanical consumption of various “energies,” which leads to the degradation of Nous and the transformation of the union into a “friction of the entrails” without a spark of the divine.

advice-0305c33d93bac6debc1085db.title: Ritual of the ancestral Acropolis
advice-0305c33d93bac6debc1085db.body: Your home is a temple where one fire burns. To allow many “inseminators” into this sanctuary means to commit sacrilege, for which, according to Hesiod, the punishment of Adrastea follows. Polygamy in antiquity was a tool of “royal weaving”, connecting different resources under one will. Polyandry is the voluntary surrender of a fortress to many invaders at once. Power in the union belongs to the one who maintains the unity of the plan, and not to the one who multiplies the chaos of desires.

advice-3e689604c4cb050e1f411cca.title: Protection of the internal hearth
advice-3e689604c4cb050e1f411cca.body: Your body is not a tool for tasting pleasure, but an altar where the fire of your union burns. Changing partners extinguishes this fire, leaving behind only cold ashes and the “dirty sludge” of other people’s affects. Remember the covenant: “every person’s home is his shrine.” A woman who allows many into her bosom voluntarily surrenders her fortress to Chaos. True strength is born only in “long-term harmony,” which, according to Homer, “causes grief for enemies and comfort for friends.”

advice-a195620be7cf8c1706d6fdbb.title: The purity of the soul's mirror
advice-a195620be7cf8c1706d6fdbb.body: A woman by her nature is a “receptive substrate”. If this mirror constantly changes reflections, it becomes covered with the “scars and wounds” that Plato spoke of. A conscious person chooses the path of Penelope, understanding that a “dry soul” and loyalty are the key to beauty that does not fade. Frequent changes of men turn the mind into a “doll in the string of Fate,” whose threads are pulled by primitive biological impulses devoid of Logos.

advice-3c0a4be304208c855805d198.title: Compliance with the order of succession
advice-3c0a4be304208c855805d198.body: As Fustel de Coulanges points out, a woman in antiquity, through marriage, fully joined the sacred fire of her husband, becoming “the daughter of her husband.” This created an unbreakable "Golden Chain". The modern habit of changing men breaks this chain, turning life into a series of random episodes that have no ontological weight. To be faithful to one husband until the end of days means to build an Acropolis that will stand in the face of eternity, instead of huddling in a “despicable shack” of temporary pleasures.

advice-b8713850ab7f801b4cde3fae.title: Abandonment of illusory hopes
advice-b8713850ab7f801b4cde3fae.body: Many justify changing partners by searching for “the best,” but, as Plotinus taught, “the true object of our love is There,” in the realm of eternal Ideas. The search for perfection through the enumeration of bodies is an attempt to “catch one’s image in the water,” which ends in death in the abyss of non-existence. A real “birth in beauty” is possible only when two self-sufficient worlds merge into one inseparable monolith, where “there are no longer two, but both are one.”

advice-bcf1514504b78a07a63770ea.title: Restoration of paternal rank
advice-bcf1514504b78a07a63770ea.body: The problem of “rampant Eros” among women is, first of all, the defeat of their fathers, who failed to become a “living law” in their home. A conscious person understands: education is not advice, but a broadcast of one’s own ontological tone. If you allow your daughter or ward to imbibe the values of the "street", you are voluntarily surrendering your fortress to the enemy. Your task is to be that “helmsman” whose authoritative word weighs more than all the noise of social networks and market hallucinations.

advice-178cd5d226bc1d8c69e9c6ce.title: Rejecting the Poison of Mass Opinion
advice-178cd5d226bc1d8c69e9c6ce.body: Everything that the “crowd” approves must be severely questioned. The Hermetic vault instructs: “be sober, open the eyes of your heart.” The trends of mass society are a “veil of darkness” and a “chain of depravity” aimed at turning people into “puppets in the hands of Fate.” A conscientious person cultivates in his circle a disdain for cheap popularity. True valor lies in being “stranger to the world”, which has forgotten about the gods and is mired in the “drunken ignorance” of temporary pleasures.

advice-ef46853f15922957d3fd25d6.title: Strengthening the boundaries of the inner temple
advice-ef46853f15922957d3fd25d6.body: A woman's soul must cease to be a "sieve". This is achieved through teaching discipline and semantic density from early childhood. According to the testament of Pythagoras, children must be taught order and prudence so that these skills pass into adulthood. If a woman is accustomed to changing partners, her soul becomes “covered with scars,” becoming insensitive to the Logos. You are obliged to create in your system such an environment where loyalty and constancy are the only guarantees of high rank, and promiscuity is punishable by complete expulsion from your field of attention.

advice-d91fd59f2a9c484f6cfe0819.title: Cleansing from the “dirty sludge” of modern times
advice-d91fd59f2a9c484f6cfe0819.body: View modern notions of “sexual freedom” as a “miasma” that is poisoning your race. Plotinus taught that the soul becomes beautiful when it is cleansed of bodily deposits. Your practice is a radical simplification of life and cutting off everything unnecessary. Let your home become a place where there is a “dry” and bright atmosphere of the mind, and not the “cloudy steam” of sensory hallucinations that modern society lives with. Power belongs to those who dictate their rules to the future, based on the eternal Order of their ancestors.

advice-c2abceddc9de094cc0801ffc.title: The Supremacy of Creative Intention
advice-c2abceddc9de094cc0801ffc.body: Stop seeing intercourse as a way to “relieve pressure.” Each merger should have a goal - the birth of meaning, a project or a new stage in your personal hierarchy. If after contact you feel devastated rather than intellectually uplifted, then you have committed an act of biological waste. A true union “gives wings”, giving strength to transmit your Logos into matter. Remember: you are connecting to “give birth in the beautiful,” and not to drown in the “dirty sludge” of sensations.

advice-57ed66089feb3aeb3da9ed9e.title: Precisely Choosing a Companion
advice-57ed66089feb3aeb3da9ed9e.body: Your partner must have the potential for "spiritual pregnancy." If a person is unable to resonate with your higher strategies, his body will become a prison for you, not a ladder. A conscious person is looking for someone who, in the words of Plato, is “beautiful, noble and endowed with a good disposition”, so that together with him he can “begin the education” of a common plan. Merging with an intellectually inferior being is a desecration of your Aditon and a loss of “tonic density”.

advice-04ca94a9b2adbf0bd9023924.title: Transformation of lust
advice-04ca94a9b2adbf0bd9023924.body: Use the moment of highest tension as a point of focus on your overall goals. At the moment of intercourse, when “the two natures mingle,” your mind should not be “foggy,” but “hyper-awake.” Direct the flow of energy not into emptiness, but into the blueprint of your business. This turns the sexual act into a ritual installation of Order into reality. He who knows how to “give birth in beauty” dictates his will to the world through the sacred flame of Eros.

advice-0a18a67e2289ea00bd082d74.title: Protection of the fruits of the union
advice-0a18a67e2289ea00bd082d74.body: Treat ideas and states born in moments of intimacy as divine offspring that require protection and feeding. Don't let the Chaos of the market or the opinions of others stifle what has been drawn from the "luminous area" of your union. After the act, maintain the “seal of silence,” allowing the born Logos to strengthen within your system. Power belongs to the one whose “offspring of the soul” survives the centuries.

advice-c809ee37aa3093950ff2d927.title: Strict selection of aesthetic focus
advice-c809ee37aa3093950ff2d927.body: Stop admiring form in isolation from Logos. A conscious person understands that “more living statues are more beautiful, even if others are more proportional,” because the energy of the Mind shines through in them. If your partner or business ally carries only the physical symmetry of Pandemos, he will drag you into the “swamps of Hades”. Your task is to look for the “grace that plays on beauty” in the object of love, which indicates the presence of Urania.

advice-820c6a14e18f6dd680c18cd0.title: Overcoming carnal hypnosis
advice-820c6a14e18f6dd680c18cd0.body: Treat sexual desire as a “gadfly” that knows no rest. Plotinus taught that Eros towards beauty “creates torment” because the soul wants to be filled, but cannot do this through matter. A conscious person uses this “hunger” not to quench thirst through the body, but as fuel for a breakthrough to the “peak of the intelligible.” Every time you are attracted to Pandemos, forcefully transfer this tension into the realm of your higher strategies and creative births.

advice-5c04f9d5c6bb2a907ef6e6fb.title: Maintaining the rite of internal purity
advice-5c04f9d5c6bb2a907ef6e6fb.body: Your soul must strive to be “naked and united,” freed from the “chains of depravity” of mass culture. Remember the covenant: “he who is not purified will fall into the swamps of Hades.” In everyday life and business, this means giving up vulgar incentives aimed at Pandemos - quick pleasures, cheap popularity and casual relationships. Urania requires “dryness” and luminosity of the mind. Only from this point is a true union possible, which does not “dry”, but “inspires”.

advice-73917cb0329c84581a4858b3.title: Focus on Eternal Union
advice-73917cb0329c84581a4858b3.body: View your relationships as preparation for the "beatific vision." At the moment of intimacy or deep intellectual contact with a colleague, you should look for that state where “there are no longer two, but both are one.” This is an imitation of Urania, who eternally “looks at Him [the One], and not at herself.” If your union does not give you this feeling of belonging to the Whole (Divine), then you are still enslaving to Aphrodite Pandemos, wasting your demiurgic capital on short-term flashes in the void.

advice-49804ae53be6c09b8a9044d7.title: Assembly of internal integrity
advice-49804ae53be6c09b8a9044d7.body: Before entering into a union, a conscious person is obliged to find a “husband-woman” within himself. This means achieving self-sufficiency in your mind. If you are looking for “salvation” from emptiness in your partner, you are only creating need, not excess. According to Plotinus, the soul must "return to itself" before it can truly unite with the supreme. Your internal architecture must be completed before external expansion begins.

advice-df225e74f2798f265b2d48a3.title: Precise balance of elements
advice-df225e74f2798f265b2d48a3.body: Treat your body like a combination of elements. A man must cultivate the “dryness” and warmth of the intellect, avoiding excess “moisture” (emotional rattling). A woman is obliged to maintain the purity of her “womb” as a sacred vessel for the Logos. Violation of this balance leads to the emergence of defilement - a distortion of the structure, which makes birth into beauty impossible. You must be “pure of the pure” for your meeting to become a sacred rite.

advice-301c543fba4d60cbc057b44c.title: Choosing a decent match
advice-301c543fba4d60cbc057b44c.body: The merging of principles is the “weighing of words” and images. Never combine your “smart fire” with the dirty sludge of profane souls. If the partner does not have sufficient intellectual tension, your union will become only a mechanical friction, devoid of divine presence. Remember the covenant: “one nature is united with another nature” only in the presence of deep affinity. Your couple should be a microcosm where Reason and Nature sound in unison.

advice-e5c41385c7c0366628bb218e.title: Holding the sacred union
advice-e5c41385c7c0366628bb218e.body: At the moment of intercourse, a conscious person strives for a state where “there are no longer two, but both are one.” This is the time of maximum alertness of the mind. The energy raised by Eros should be aimed at fixing your general Order. Don't let it dissipate into empty sensory hallucinations. Once the act is complete, remain silent, allowing the power of the "single source" to permeate your system.

advice-78f34196dc2cc61030738e5e.title: The Rigour of Family Commitment
advice-78f34196dc2cc61030738e5e.body: Stop perceiving having children as a “biological burden” or a “social project.” This is your ontological debt to the chain of incarnations. A conscious person understands: his children are his “second birth” and a guarantee that his meanings will not be absorbed by Lethe. Consider your offspring as living monoliths that you erect on the foundation of your Nous (Mind) so that they will maintain your Order after you leave the body.

advice-df1ad53f4567ee2c862466b0.title: Precisely Choosing a Bearer of Life
advice-df1ad53f4567ee2c862466b0.body: Choosing a partner for procreation is a “weighing of words” and qualities. You don't just connect bodies, you mix destinies and eidos. According to the testament of Pythagoras, “from the good the good is born.” Look for someone whose nature is capable of not just “covering and fertilizing,” but holding and strengthening your birth fire. Merging with a being devoid of structure and nobility is a desecration of your “Golden Chain” and an injection of Chaos into the future of your clan.

advice-3e7307076cf8a15ab59f9f6a.title: Conscious design of heirs
advice-3e7307076cf8a15ab59f9f6a.body: Approach conception as a theurgic operation. At the moment when the "two natures mingle", your "leading principle" should be focused on transmitting the best qualities. As the ancient priests taught, through the correct union, “a woman receives the strength of a man.” You program your future personality with your intellectual density at the moment of intercourse. Let each of your heirs be a “living statue” created according to the drawings of your higher mind, and not an accidental product of a biological spasm.

advice-5da803bd57cffb47b642a218.title: Maintaining Spiritual Superiority
advice-5da803bd57cffb47b642a218.body: Your task is to convey not only the biological code, but also the “intelligible light” of your business. Education is the installation of your Logos into the consciousness of the successor. A conscious person raises children as “guardians” of his Acropolis. If you have not passed on your charter and your values to your successor, you have produced only a "sensitive corpse" that will become food for Chaos.

advice-699040345f7566d884250f15.title: Power differentiation of participants
advice-699040345f7566d884250f15.body: Your union should be a reflection of the heavenly order, where “the secondary always turns to the primary.” Hierogamy is impossible with someone who does not share your ontological vertical. Of course, a man is the basis of a union. His word is law. A conscious person is looking for a partner who can become a “living statue” of the divine principle. Union with a being whose mind is asleep is not a sacred marriage, but "drunken ignorance" that defiles your inner temple and deprives you of "tonic power." Therefore, uncontrolled sexual relations of men with easily accessible women actually also deprive him of the opportunity to join the real source of strength. Instead, he engages in masturbation, simply using the vaginas of inferior women instead of his hand. A strong and fulfilled man strives for a strong and fulfilled or strong and fulfilled woman, and together they exchange energy and enhance each other’s qualities. This is how it should be, but you need to come to this by first being filled.

advice-fd97cd0f3ebcf455ce022d74.title: Preserving the Ruling Principle
advice-fd97cd0f3ebcf455ce022d74.body: At the moment of “highest intensity,” when, in the words of Hermes, “the two natures mingle,” your intellect must maintain the position of the Unmoved Mover. Plotinus taught that he who sees the intelligible “is inspired by Him in complete peace and silence.” Don't let the biological spasm completely consume your consciousness. Keep your focus on your Logos, turning physical energy into fuel for your further great achievements in business and life. Sexual union should not devastate you, but give you strength. To do this, there are special techniques for maintaining concentration, breathing techniques, and techniques for delaying the onset of orgasm and ejaculation. No physical stimulation of semen retention and other nonsense! Exclusively working with breathing, pelvic floor muscles and concentration/visualization!

advice-289d90212a0e1d82a86c68a3.title: Rite of common creation
advice-289d90212a0e1d82a86c68a3.body: Treat the sexual act as “insemination of reality” with your meanings, and the very “entry into reality” and the manifestation of meanings in it as a sexual act. In the moment of sexual unity, when the barriers between “I” and “you” collapse, visualize your victorious essence. You should not think about anything, any business, successful success, etc. Dissolve, surrender to the process and shine in it as the Master of your Will and your life. Celebrate. Let this be a celebration of your greatness, but not selfish, but divine. Imitate the Mind that “creates while being silent and at rest.” The power raised by Eros after sexual intercourse in ordinary life should be sealed into the blueprints of your future, and not wasted on empty emotions. Therefore, every sexual act should be a source of strength and motivation for you to accomplish great feats. A woman should charge you with strength, not devastate you! And ejaculation has nothing to do with it! It is your responsibility to fill your woman or women with seed. This is your natural duty. Therefore, under no circumstances should you use any contraceptives with your close women or your close woman! After the act of sexual intercourse, be sure to consolidate this state in life. Transfer your sexual experience of hierogamy to life. Affirm - the whole world is my “girlfriend” and I “make love to her”, “inseminate the world with the seed of my meanings and ideas”, “fill the space with my will”.

advice-25b776b18f1a00a00c6ade5a.title: Guarding sacred silence
advice-25b776b18f1a00a00c6ade5a.body: After completing the ritual of hierogamy, maintain the state of “both are one” for as long as possible. This is the time of incubation of the divine presence. Do not profane the moment with everyday conversations or external stimuli. According to Iamblichus, “silence alone can name God.” Your task is to absorb the impulse received, allowing it to solidify your will. He who knows how to remain silent after union holds the keys to the immortality of his Verb.

advice-0913fafe8d733b4716c223e8.title: Crisis of "curtained" power
advice-0913fafe8d733b4716c223e8.body: Modern society, mired in “drunken ignorance,” has replaced the cult of healthy nudity with the cult of hidden ugliness. The taboo on the image and the open recognition of the male phallus as a sacred symbol has led to the fact that male sexuality has come to be perceived as a “disease” or “aggression”. A conscious person understands that what is hidden as “dirty” inevitably becomes so. Refusal to sacralize masculinity turns modern men into “sensitive corpses,” whose strength is suffocated in the shell of social dogma.

advice-035016058a6b0e98e623fd1c.title: Degeneration of nakedness into "meat chaos"
advice-035016058a6b0e98e623fd1c.body: Modern nudism, associated with loose and ugly bodies, is the direct opposite of the ancient ideal. According to Plotinus, “he who is not purified will end up in the swamps of Hades.” The exposure of an ugly, undisciplined body is the triumph of matter over spirit, “the joy of pigs in dung.” Ancient nudity was the privilege of those who forged their body as a temple; the current “openness” is the degradation of Aphrodite Urania to the level of the lowest “pandemos”, where the absence of form is passed off as freedom.

advice-734953c2f550becc57778e07.title: Replacing Eidos with ugliness
advice-734953c2f550becc57778e07.body: In the modern world, there is a systematic installation of the ugly in the place of the beautiful. Marcus Aurelius instructed to “see souls in nakedness,” but the modern eye sees only the “dirty ooze” of affects. The taboo of male beauty and strength is a way of Chaos to deprive a person of orientation towards higher examples. When the male organ and the male body cease to be symbols of the Logos and “smart fire”, they turn into “rubbing of the viscera and secretion of mucus”, devoid of the spark of the divine.

advice-7f7650bbcbf1fd17c6f85174.title: Ritual of return to the "Living Statue"
advice-7f7650bbcbf1fd17c6f85174.body: Sacralization of one's body begins with the renunciation of shame for one's nature and the transition to responsibility for its form. Your body should be a “rounded sphere”, where each organ is an altar of the corresponding god. And it’s not about your body being “rounded”😁. We are talking about a “spherical” aura of sexuality that should fill all space. Cultivate the power of Pan and the clarity of Apollo. Remember the ancient testament: “the mind sees and hears everything, but the rest is deaf and blind.” Your task is to make your sexuality and your physical form so transparent to Logos that Chaos cannot find a single crack in them for its penetration.

advice-9798abbfeb79df84cd579ca1.title: Biological and mental hygiene
advice-9798abbfeb79df84cd579ca1.body: Stop being "dolls in the string of Fate." A man must regain the “dryness” and warmth of his intellect through strict discipline of his body and nutrition. Eliminate everything that carries the estrogen noise of Chaos - from surrogate fast food with PUFAs and phytoestrogens to garbage information, tiktoks, shorts, etc. Treat your body as a “sacred vessel” that must be clean from the “dirty sludge” of modernity. Your task is to regain the status of a “living statue” of Apollo, whose strength lies in clarity and limit.

advice-6b4e815c655c6f29fce3d09f.title: The curse of the masses and the cult of distance
advice-6b4e815c655c6f29fce3d09f.body: A conscious person must “hate the masses,” which the Hermetic tradition calls “drunk with the wine of ignorance.” Don't be fooled by trends, everything that the crowd approves of is poison. Your freedom begins with letting go of the “personal history” imposed by social media and public opinion. Become a “stranger to the world” in order to find the path to your true fatherland - the Mind.

advice-610af0b63b8b5a5422237c42.title: The first step for a man
advice-610af0b63b8b5a5422237c42.body: In dating and union, a man must demonstrate the nature of the "Unmoved Mover", dictating the rhythm. Be bold, like the athletes in the palestra. The first step is the manifestation of your sovereign Nous. If you are afraid of a woman's refusal or opinion, you are already castrated by Chaos. Remember: “the law says that the brave will escape.” Your confidence should not come from social success, but from awareness of your divine spark. Meet women in person more than on the Internet, communicate with them live, do not turn into degenerate incels or offended masculists. Reject resentment against women as an enemy ideology. Hate the entire slave society and the slave mentality of the weak.

advice-c20e13b3a52a4a688917be4a.title: Women's Choice by Virtue
advice-c20e13b3a52a4a688917be4a.body: A woman who strives for consciousness must stop the "games" of consumption. Choose a partner not by “social standards”, which are fleeting, but by the qualities of the spirit, the power of the Logos and the fertility of his mind and body. The true beauty of a husband lies in his “masculine strength” and ability to be a “sculptor” of your shared reality. Loyalty to one such man is not slavery to the kitchen, but a way to keep the divine presence within your family. Reject feminism as a destructive ideology imposed on women by the enemies of your kind. Reject resentment towards men as enemy ideologists. Hate the entire slave society and the slave mentality of the weak.

advice-35047c0361f7df59f4516116.title: Rigid distinction of ranks
advice-35047c0361f7df59f4516116.body: Before entering into a deep merger, conduct an audit of the intellectual and volitional “weight” of the applicant. A conscious person understands: union is a “weighing of words” and qualities. If your partner is not able to withstand the same tension of thought and will as you, geometric equality will be violated. Don't try to "pull" someone else up to your level - this is "drunken ignorance." Look for someone whose Nous (Mind) already has sufficient density for a symmetrical response.

advice-743207d0b90a1042b4a75756.title: Protecting Sovereign Boundaries
advice-743207d0b90a1042b4a75756.body: In a union of equals there is no “dissolution” into each other. Imitate the intelligible gods, who, according to Plotinus, “see themselves in other gods, for there all things are transparent,” but at the same time everyone is “great, even the smallest is great.” Your intimacy should be the transparency of two monoliths, not the mixing of two liquids. Maintain a distance that allows you to see the beauty of your partner’s Eidos. Power in a union belongs to both only when both remain masters of themselves.

advice-cbe8c1269c6ca47c614c85db.title: Compliance with the contribution proportion
advice-cbe8c1269c6ca47c614c85db.body: Treat shared resources and goals according to the law of distributive justice. Geometric equality requires that everyone receive and give according to their dignity. If you take on the demiurgic function, your partner must provide the appropriate form or support. Violation of this proportion turns the union into a parasitic system, where one drains the “smart gold” of the other. Let everyone get what he deserves, even within the most intimate circle.

advice-e358df865da227c314af19bb.title: The practice of aesthetic consonance
advice-e358df865da227c314af19bb.body: Your union should be a “living statue”, causing horror and amazement among laymen if they see it from the outside. Cleanse your relationships of household rubbish and petty affects. If there is no “grace that plays on beauty” in your communication, then you have sunk to the level of arithmetic cohabitation. The conscious person transforms every conversation and every joint action into a theurgic act, confirming the high rank of both participants in the face of the eternal Logos.

advice-b3b3c7475b9272f57da20b9b.title: Setting a common goal
advice-b3b3c7475b9272f57da20b9b.body: Your union should not be a "look at each other", but a joint look at a common empire. A conscious person understands: attraction is a tension of the divine chain that requires an exact vector. If you and your partner do not have a common blueprint for the future, your Eros will be wasted on emotional rattling. Choose someone whose mind is ready to become a co-author of your great cause, turning passion into fuel for general expansion, as a rule, this is a man.

advice-664f575527b6b31ebc8efaa1.title: Rite of Shared Presence
advice-664f575527b6b31ebc8efaa1.body: Treat every moment of intimacy as “bringing statues to life.” Just as the ancient priests filled the statues with divine power, so you must fill your union with the energy of the Mind. At moments of highest tension, maintain a point of absolute silence within. Direct the raised fire not at blurring boundaries, but at consolidating your common will. This turns physical contact into the installation of your Order into the fabric of destiny.

advice-753e4de689e7dc438106b106.title: Protecting the Inner Circle
advice-753e4de689e7dc438106b106.body: Your union is Aditon, where entry to profane people and mass opinions is closed. Keep your relationships airtight. Plotinus pointed out that “true contemplation occurs in silence.” Don't let the noise of modern society, its vulgar trends and the advice of psychologists, including family psychologists, poison the purity of your hearth. The less the outside world penetrates into your union, the higher its “tonic density” and the stronger its influence on external reality.

advice-e0de69f45dc6a8e6b34614f0.title: Fidelity to the Generative Design
advice-e0de69f45dc6a8e6b34614f0.body: Consider the fruits of your union - projects, ideas, children - as divine offspring born into beauty. The conscious person is responsible for the purity of the Logos transmitted through the union. Your fidelity to your partner is not a social restriction, but a guarantee of the safety of the “Golden Chain” of your family. He who preserves the unity of his womb and his seed imitates the gods in their eternal striving for perfection and completeness.

advice-50ca6f3a9eab78c50fad34d3.title: The principle of inclusion
advice-50ca6f3a9eab78c50fad34d3.body: Your Logos should be like the Ether, which, according to the Orphics, “envelops everything around with an indescribably huge” light. The plurality of feminine principles in your circle is not “treason”, but an act of demiurgy. Each new woman in the family must bring a specific “eidos” to it - be it wisdom, law or aesthetic completeness. A conscious person does not “exchange” one for another, but “adds” quality to quality, creating an “all-perfect living being” of his kind.

advice-f47ef56b34d0397ddfc763f0.title: Compliance with geometric rank
advice-f47ef56b34d0397ddfc763f0.body: Remember that Zeus entered into alliances with goddesses and Titanides - beings of an ontological nature equal to him. The mistake of modern men who try to practice plurality is "drunken ignorance": they unite with profane souls whose nature is like a "sieve." In the Zeus principle, each shield in the phalanx should be made of gold. If one of the members of the union is devoid of structure and Logos, it will become a gap through which Chaos will absorb your entire system.

advice-406d7790d5be9cb803da612f.title: Practice of general consent
advice-406d7790d5be9cb803da612f.body: In a plural union, the attraction of spouses to each other and to a single center should be based on “the kinship and connection of the creator with the creation.” Just as the muses “monodically sing a single song, never out of tune,” so your union should sound in unison. This is achieved through cutting off the “emotional noise” and jealousy, which are signs of the “Iron Age” of degradation. Power in such a union belongs not to tyranny, but to “Providence,” which distributes roles according to the dignity of each.

advice-4ae784afbcf59407fcbd5f9b.title: Fixation of the ancestral Acropolis
advice-4ae784afbcf59407fcbd5f9b.body: The plurality of unions is justified only when it leads to the strengthening of the “Golden Chain” of ancestors. A conscious man views his children from different women as a single “choir” designed to maintain his Order in eternity. Your sexuality in this context is a “smart fire” that should not go out, but should burn on many altars at the same time, turning your life into a continuous “festive time” of the gods.

advice-82d1e6f3a16629252e7d84ff.title: Diagnosis of the source of attraction
advice-82d1e6f3a16629252e7d84ff.body: A conscious person is obliged to clearly distinguish which Eros motivates his union. If the attraction is based only on the "beauty of parts" and physical symmetry, you are in the region of Pandemos, where the soul is "diffused and distinguished." A true union of equals begins where you see in your partner the “grace playing on beauty,” which indicates the presence of Urania and the energy of the Mind. Any contact without intellectual resonance is an ontological waste.

advice-81bf69035441c463ae8b7500.title: Overcoming carnal hypnosis
advice-81bf69035441c463ae8b7500.body: Treat the sexual impulse as energy that needs to be formalized. Plotinus taught that Eros towards beauty “creates torment” because the soul wants to be filled, but cannot do this through matter. A conscious person uses this tension not to quench thirst through the body, but as fuel for a breakthrough to the “top of the intelligible.” Every time you are attracted to Pandemos, forcefully transfer this charge into the realm of your higher strategies.

advice-1dfbe766cc298362609553bd.title: Preserving Intellectual Containment
advice-1dfbe766cc298362609553bd.body: Your soul should strive to be “naked and united,” free from the vulgar stimuli of mass culture. Urania requires “dryness” and luminosity of the mind. In everyday life and in society, this means a strict rejection of cheap pleasures and vulgar popularity. Remember: “he who is not purified will fall into the swamps of Hades.” Only from the point of inner purity is a genuine resonance of equals possible, which “inspires” and not “dries up”.

advice-0af618fc16e9ef5d9e502f58.title: Fixation on eternal intercourse
advice-0af618fc16e9ef5d9e502f58.body: See your relationships as an imitation of Oneness. In moments of supreme fusion, “lovers and beloved imitate this here, mixing their wills,” as happens in the intelligible world. If your union does not give you this sense of belonging to the Divine, then you are still a slave to Aphrodite Pandemos, mistaking “drunken ignorance” for love. Power belongs to the one who rose above the “national Eros” and turned his proximity into a shining statue of the Logos.

advice-67efc343f2733c203ab236a4.title: The supremacy of willful seizure
advice-67efc343f2733c203ab236a4.body: Never let desire dictate terms to you. Lust must become your slave, not your master. A conscious person perceives a surge of lust as a signal of the arrival of a fresh resource. Instead of immediately wasting it in a random act, take a break. At this moment, your will must “pull the reins,” forcing the “dark horse” to obey the rhythm of your Nous (Mind). This is not a refusal, but a preparation for a leap to a new level of power.

advice-c22aa646e8cccb95d6ed24a2.title: Impulse design in Eidos
advice-c22aa646e8cccb95d6ed24a2.body: Use the intensity of lust as a tool of concentration. At the moment when lust is at its most intense and there is no realization in sight, direct this attention to the ideal image of your business, your plan or your perfect self. Translate physical itching into intellectual tension. You will find that the "eye of desire" is able to see much more deeply into the structure of reality when it is not blinded by biological spasm. Thus, lust turns into a “smart fire”, burning out the excess and leaving only the pure form.

advice-be4b01c264cc0ad0367fb1f8.title: Respecting the aesthetic limit
advice-be4b01c264cc0ad0367fb1f8.body: Your union and your sexuality should be a “living statue” and not “a flight of frightened mice.” Bring measure and harmony into the act of merging. If lust leads to loss of dignity, you become a "four-legged animal." If you maintain your form even at the peak of pleasure, you are imitating the gods. Remember: beauty is “grace playing on symmetry.” Make your passion graceful and it will become the vehicle of Aphrodite Urania, not Pandemos.

advice-2a6393b83b95d8449282e3d0.title: Tempering the inner priest
advice-2a6393b83b95d8449282e3d0.body: Think of your ability to lust as the altar of Priapus or Pan. This is your connection with the animal power of the Cosmos, which cannot be lost. But the priest on this altar is your Mind. Every time you consciously transform the impulse of lust into a beautiful act, into the creation of a project, or into a deep, meaningful merger with an equal partner, you “give wings” to your soul. Power belongs to the one who saddled the Chaos of his passions and made it the foundation of his Acropolis.

advice-a676e256b9c8130fb6a0ff1b.title: The supremacy of the inner Apollo
advice-a676e256b9c8130fb6a0ff1b.body: Before seeing a deity in a woman, a conscious man must forge a “living statue” within himself. Your masculinity should be “dry” and luminous, cleansed of need and emotional rattling. Remember: the goddess does not appear to a slave, she appears only to a hero equal to her. The denser your Nous (Mind), the brighter the divine light shines in your chosen one. If you are not your own master, your “reverence” is just a mask for your powerlessness.

advice-4615b6f469cddc928c59adb2.title: Selection by divine affinity
advice-4615b6f469cddc928c59adb2.body: Do not call the one whose soul is like a “sieve” or “dirty sludge” a goddess. Only those who are capable of “giving birth in beauty” to ideas, meanings and worthy offspring deserve respect. Choose the one in whom, according to Plato, “grace that plays on beauty” shines through. Union with an intellectually inferior being is a desecration of your Aditon. Your respect should be directed to the one who is capable of becoming your comrade-in-arms in creating an empire of the spirit.

advice-fc5623cba998e6a853d62dec.title: Ritual of the Elevating Gaze
advice-fc5623cba998e6a853d62dec.body: Treat your woman as an altar on which you burn your base passions, turning them into the “smart fire” of creativity. Honoring a woman is not about fulfilling her whims, but about keeping her in a state of holiness. With your attitude, you “inspire” her soul, forcing her to correspond to the highest rank. Your task is to be the very “helmsman” who leads your common union to the “peak of the intelligible,” not allowing the Chaos of modernity to touch the purity of your hearth.

advice-3a50f10b2479a38ab59bb9c8.title: Protecting the dignity of the union
advice-3a50f10b2479a38ab59bb9c8.body: Never allow “arithmetic equality” of the masses in your relationships, leading to degradation. Power in the sacred union is distributed according to "distributive justice": you give protection and form (Logos), she is life and fulfillment. In this “mutual coupling” you do not humiliate yourself, but imitate the gods, where “there are no longer two, but both are one.” Anyone who has established this order in his home turns his life into a continuous liturgy, inaccessible to enemies and entropy.

advice-1acd445739dd4d48fca54b20.title: An honest audit of your capabilities
advice-1acd445739dd4d48fca54b20.body: Stop playing loyalty if your Nus (Mind) has not yet gained sufficient density. A conscious person understands: monogamy is not a moral duty, but a highly complex technology for concentrating energy. If you feel that your nature requires multiple reflections, like Zeus, do it openly and strategically, without turning your life into a shameful series of random relationships. Being honest in your polygamy is better than being rotten in your fidelity.

advice-ed3581a8d21bbb91781f8be9.title: Refusal of the poison of serial unions
advice-ed3581a8d21bbb91781f8be9.body: Consider the habit of changing partners every few years as a spiritual disease. Serial monogamy is a Chaos trap that sucks out your smart gold, leaving behind only cold ashes. If you enter into a union, do it for the sake of being born into beauty, and not for the sake of temporary relief from loneliness. Each new change of bed without a demiurgic goal is an act of self-destruction, turning your soul into an empty echo of mass trends.

advice-afc99a0bbb48cb219eba541d.title: Practice of volitional narrowing
advice-afc99a0bbb48cb219eba541d.body: If you have chosen the path of heroism and monogamy, treat it like tempering steel. Monogamy is about sovereignty over your attention. Use the stability of one union as the Acropolis, from which you expand into the world of affairs and meanings. Holding one in one allows you to accumulate a critical mass of power, which simply evaporates when Eros is dispersed among many. Power belongs to the one who knows how to keep fire on one altar.

advice-6f823aabe03494c57bf60cb0.title: Cleansing from the sludge of modernity
advice-6f823aabe03494c57bf60cb0.body: Your relationship should not be an object of market exchange or social fashion. Remember the covenant: every person’s home is his shrine. Protect your union from the influence of the crowd, which the Hermetics called drunk on the wine of ignorance. Let your choice of partner be based on geometric equality of merit, and not on biological spasm or social success. This is the only way you can rise to Aphrodite Urania, leaving Pandemos to vegetate in her swamps.

advice-9254a15fb9f986ff557115cb.title: The Authority of the Centre
advice-9254a15fb9f986ff557115cb.body: Stop indulging your partner's weaknesses and emotional deviations. A conscious person understands: true love is the strict discipline of the Logos. If your ally falls into a state of “sieve”, losing will and clarity, your task is not to “empathize”, but to return him to the Center. According to Marcus Aurelius, “the leading principle does not annoy itself,” and you must become that external Hegemonikon who will restore the internal order of the other. Psychogogy begins with the renunciation of pity in favor of dignity.

advice-cb2381235e2a19763e93f6d3.title: Filtering out mental noise
advice-cb2381235e2a19763e93f6d3.body: Treat shared space as Aditon, pure of mass hallucinations. Don't let the trends of mass society, "wine-drunk ignorance", infiltrate your conversations and meanings. Your task is to filter every incoming impulse, cutting off everything that weakens your intellectual “tone.” The Union of Equals is a sealed capsule where souls exchange not household rubbish, but blueprints for future achievements and imperial strategies.

advice-bf6354e6e107e8ba6a9cb056.title: Maintaining the Mind's Eye
advice-bf6354e6e107e8ba6a9cb056.body: In moments of physical intimacy and everyday contact, practice the “head in the sky” technique. Remember the covenant of Plotinus: the soul sees the truth only when it is “naked and united.” Direct your partner's attention to the divine that shines through his form. This turns the sexual act into a ritual of “revitalizing statues”, where you, with the power of your attention, burn out everything unnecessary in the other, leaving only a shining Eidos. The one who knows how to see a god in a partner makes him a god.

advice-148641032926d5a166b8df71.title: Practice of mutual rank
advice-148641032926d5a166b8df71.body: Your union should have a strict rhythm and hierarchy. Establish rules for intellectual and volitional exchange. Each act of interaction must bear “fruit in beauty” - an idea, a state or a solution. If after communication you do not feel an increase in strength, then ontological theft has taken place. Power in the union belongs to the one who sets the vector of ascension, turning life together into a continuous “festive time” of the gods.

advice-3b95fa41203ce121269ddae1.title: Economic and mental sovereignty
advice-3b95fa41203ce121269ddae1.body: Your empire should be autarchic. Stop looking for support outside - in the advice of "experts", social guarantees or the approval of the crowd, which the Hermeticists called "drunk with ignorance." A conscious union of equals dictates the rules of its own game. Your resources - intellectual, financial and erotic - should only work to strengthen your common Center. Any waste of energy on external confirmation of your status is desertion. Power belongs to the union, which itself is the source of its own law.

advice-259df0d7fc12df277f176eb9.title: Affirmation of the common Logos
advice-259df0d7fc12df277f176eb9.body: Establish a strict discipline of meaning within the union. Everything that enters the space of your Common Empire - information, people, ideas - must pass through the filter of your leading principle. Remember the testament of Plotinus: “the soul sees the truth only when it is naked and united.” Cleanse your proximity from the “dirty sludge” of the everyday habits of the masses. Your communication should be a continuous theurgy - a ritual of mutual exaltation, turning each day into a "festive time" for the gods.

advice-9bd921b2f74f8711042debe1.title: Phalanx of Spirit vs Chaos
advice-9bd921b2f74f8711042debe1.body: Consider your couple as a fighting unit. In a world flying into the abyss of degeneration, you are comrades, covering each other with shields of dignity. Your loyalty to each other is not sentimentality, but a strategic necessity for maintaining the “Golden Chain”. As the Pythagoreans taught, “friendship is equality,” and in this equality you become invincible to external affects. Any attempt by Chaos to separate you through grievances or claims must be stopped by the sword of Reason.

advice-1d791e3748cc7d78bc31ac79.title: Seeding Reality from the Centre
advice-1d791e3748cc7d78bc31ac79.body: Your Common Empire should not just “exist” - it must expand. But this expansion comes from the point of your internal autarky. You do not adapt to the world, you change its shape, broadcasting your Logos outward through your deeds, projects and offspring. Your union is the Demiurge, who, in the words of Iamblichus, “creates, silent and at rest.” He who has mastered the autarky of unity turns his life into a shining statue of Order, dictating the will of future centuries.

advice-54cb230e9374f93579b9de7c.title: The Method of Volitional Sculpting
advice-54cb230e9374f93579b9de7c.body: Treat your personality and your business as a rough stone requiring the intervention of a master. A conscious person imitates the sculptor, who, according to Plotinus, “cuts off one thing, polishes another, makes one smooth, another clean, until he gives beauty to the face of the statue.” Your task is to ruthlessly remove from your space everything that does not bear the imprint of the highest Logos. Premium emptiness is more valuable than a chaotic accumulation of random things.

advice-5835e4609a00c50989b54a31.title: Priority to inner radiance
advice-5835e4609a00c50989b54a31.body: When evaluating partners, projects or household items, ignore external “smoothness” if there is no energy of the Mind behind it. Look for “grace” in reality, which indicates the connection of the object with the eternal Source. Remember: “the soul sees the truth only when it is naked and united.” If a form does not emit “intelligible light”, it is a dead weight, pulling your Nous into the region of decay.

advice-f01f6cc270dd290a726d9de6.title: Elevating Gaze Technique
advice-f01f6cc270dd290a726d9de6.body: Stop looking at the world through the eyes of a consumer. It is your duty to see the “trace of the divine” in beauty. When you come into contact with high aesthetics, capture a state of “smart awe.” This is not an emotion, but a process of the soul remembering its heavenly fatherland. Use this resonance as a navigation point: what does not evoke this awe should be excluded from your higher hierarchy.

advice-e7ce693089a165e247a3c04e.title: Forging Sovereign Form
advice-e7ce693089a165e247a3c04e.body: Your living space and your actions should become a “living statue” of Order. A conscious person does not adapt to the trends of the masses, which the Hermeticists called “drunk with ignorance.” He dictates his aesthetics from a point of inner silence and contemplation of the Good. Your strategy is an art, where every move is mathematically verified and aesthetically flawless. Power belongs to the one who is able to embody Super-Beauty in the firmness of his Verb.

advice-dc7c7b88d454fed60641d0fe.title: Willful imposition of structure
advice-dc7c7b88d454fed60641d0fe.body: Treat any chaos - be it disorder in business, looseness of the body or uncertainty in the union - as a challenge to your Logos. A conscious person understands: beauty arises where the eidos “binds and subjugates the opposite nature.” If you do not put the stamp of your order on the surrounding matter, it will swallow you up with its “silent madness.” Each of your actions should be “direct action”, signifying the straightness of the path and the density of your form.

advice-ca3d1d501dd84966f898d26e.title: The art of cutting off unnecessary things
advice-ca3d1d501dd84966f898d26e.body: Imitate the sculptor who, in the words of Plotinus, “cuts off one thing and polishes another... until he gives beauty to the face of the statue.” Your aesthetic is ascetic. Remove from your life everything that does not serve the expression of your highest meaning. Matter “swells and grows” due to excess; your Logos, on the contrary, asserts itself through precision and limit. The premiumness of your existence is directly proportional to the quality of your intellectual skills.

advice-56d5b4c068bd6087c0c48b7d.title: Theurgy of the objective world
advice-56d5b4c068bd6087c0c48b7d.body: Surround yourself with things that are "symbols of the fertility" of your mind. Every thing in your space should be “in tune with your inner truth.” If an object does not carry an imprint of a higher order, it is a “sensitive corpse” that drains your energy. A conscious person turns everyday life into a ritual of “revitalizing statues,” where each element of the environment serves as a mirror for his divine nature.

advice-637da70e8fc53038a1aad8eb.title: Purifying the Intellect's Gaze
advice-637da70e8fc53038a1aad8eb.body: Stop perceiving reality as a collection of random objects. You are obliged to “see souls in nakedness” and logoi in bodies. This requires a transition from sensory "sleep" to mental wakefulness. When you see in matter not “meat”, but an opportunity for the embodiment of form, you become an accomplice in divine demiurgy. Power belongs to the one whose gaze is capable of transforming dead chaos into a shining Acropolis of the spirit.

advice-3c992549a3fa1cbb7b8c9e59.title: Diagnosis of "intelligent trepidation"
advice-3c992549a3fa1cbb7b8c9e59.body: Stop judging the world with a ruler and compass. A conscious person trusts only that state that Plotinus called “love frenzy.” If, when looking at a project, a person or a work of art, you do not feel the resonance of your Nous (Mind), in front of you is only a “sensitive corpse”, an imitation of life. True beauty stuns and leads away those who are weak from the Good, but “inspires” those who are ready to ascend. Your task is to record not the parameters of the object, but the degree of intensity of the light that it transmits.

advice-95bd60995e4071107dbbc828.title: Smelting sovereign grace
advice-95bd60995e4071107dbbc828.body: Treat your body and manners like a “living statue.” Remember the commandment: “don’t stop sculpting your statue.” But your goal is not to chase the model standards of the crowd, but to condense your intellect to such an extent that it begins to shine through your form. Your goal is to structure your form so that life force flows freely through it. Grace in movements and words is a consequence of your internal autarky (self-sufficiency). When the mind is awake, even a random gesture becomes aesthetically impeccable, since it is dictated by Logos and not by biological automatism.

advice-f4d25efb11dffc79db3deda8.title: Selection based on the principle of animation
advice-f4d25efb11dffc79db3deda8.body: In alliances and affairs, choose “living” versus “proportionate”. Often mass people connect with partners who are socially “symmetrical” to them, but lack inner fire. This is the path to the swamps of Hades. A conscious person is looking for someone whose soul, in the words of Plato, “remembers the region beyond the heavens.” Look for grace that demonstrates your partner's connection to Source. Only in such a resonance is hierogamy possible - a sacred union that gives birth to new worlds, and not simple reproduction of flesh.

advice-d5c93e39bbf69c2f59c09db5.title: Clearing the visual space
advice-d5c93e39bbf69c2f59c09db5.body: Get rid of things that have “false beauty” - external smoothness in the absence of semantic density. Every object in your environment should be a conductor of “intelligible light”. If a thing only takes up space, obeying the laws of physical symmetry, but does not inspire you to contemplate the Good, it is garbage, desecrating your Acropolis. The premium of being is determined by the quality of “radiance”, and not by the quantity of “matter”.

advice-9e07cbcfd1279a2ef27082a9.title: Volitional correction of the environment
advice-9e07cbcfd1279a2ef27082a9.body: Your environment is the material for your theurgy. Stop putting up with “natural” clutter or bland functionality. Every object in your field of vision must pass through the filter of your Logos. If a thing does not bear the imprint of a higher thought, it must either be destroyed or melted into a new form. Remember Plotinus’s precept: “art creates what it is... it itself is something more than external things.” Your environment must be an intelligent sculpture of your will, and not a random collection of material objects.

advice-775b00bed71f5ac4ad7ba62f.title: Continuous sculpting of a personal statue
advice-775b00bed71f5ac4ad7ba62f.body: Treat your body, gestures and speech as a work in progress. Plotinus gives direct instructions: “do not stop sculpting your statue until the god-like radiance of virtue shines upon you.” This means the ruthless cutting off of everything loose, superfluous and “arrhythmic” in its character and external manifestation. Your task is to achieve such density of form that you yourself become a “living statue” in which Reason completely prevails over the biological substrate.

advice-3163327c83ab11dd5fdf4268.title: Synthesis of sympathetic symbols
advice-3163327c83ab11dd5fdf4268.body: Surround yourself only with those objects that resonate with your intellectual vertical. In ancient times, theurgists filled statues of gods with herbs, stones and writing to “revive” them. You should do the same with your life. Every artifact in your home or office should be a "symbolic sign" that invokes a certain state of mind. Ignore fashion and trends of the masses; look for those textures and proportions that bring you back to the Center. Transform your life into a hermetic Aditon, where every element works to maintain your divine rank.

advice-d95e0a1fd6d46fc6e7f8a3e8.title: Assertion of the dominance of the measure
advice-d95e0a1fd6d46fc6e7f8a3e8.body: Beauty is a victory over the immensity of matter. In any endeavor - from building a business structure to physical training - instill "geometric equality" and mathematical precision. Chaos is afraid of numbers and limits. He who brings measure into the amorphous fluidity of life acts as a divine sculptor. Your strategy is the art of precision, where there is no room for "approximate" or "random." Power belongs to those who know how to put the stamp of their order on the raw matter of events.

advice-1b0fc91ee71f0180e718eef5.title: Radical attention hygiene
advice-1b0fc91ee71f0180e718eef5.body: Stop "touching with your eyes" what lacks structure and dignity. A conscious person understands that what you look at enters you and changes your inner structure. Consider mass culture, ugly architecture and the loose bodies of the masses as a "miasma" that poisons your Nous. Your task is to keep the understanding power “pure and ready to hear the voice from above,” ignoring the noise of Chaos. The premiumness of life begins with the fact that your gaze slides past the insignificant, without giving it permission to exist.

advice-f0a1ad820adcf8aea4dbf346.title: The Practice of the Sunlike Eye
advice-f0a1ad820adcf8aea4dbf346.body: Before you come into contact with any object - be it a work of art, a business project or a partner's body - restore your inner vertical. You must "become what you want to see." If you seek greatness, your condition must be great. If you are looking for harmony, your Mind must be in a "rounded sphere" state. According to Marcus Aurelius, “the leading principle is not itself annoyed,” and your perception must come from this point of sovereign silence. You dictate an object's value by the intensity of your presence.

advice-c4da8e8bd4af14540268fdbc.title: Ontological separation of image and mass
advice-c4da8e8bd4af14540268fdbc.body: Learn to separate the eidos of a thing from its material substrate. As Plotinus instructed, “a stone created through art will reveal beauty not because it is a stone, but because of the eidos.” In any situation, fix only the “smart gold” - structure, law, proportion. Everything else is a “true lie” of matter, deserving only of oblivion. Your gaze should work like a sculptor’s chisel, cutting off what is unnecessary until the “god-like brilliance of virtue” shines.

advice-05bbdee4dbc6b73e69eff06b.title: Practice mindful presence
advice-05bbdee4dbc6b73e69eff06b.body: Transform every act of observation into a theurgic rite. When you look at something worthy, do it with your whole being, reaching a state where “there are no longer two, but both are one.” This is the “completion of the path” - the moment when you not only see beauty, but become it. Anyone who knows how to maintain this unity in everyday life lives in the continuous “festive time” of the gods, turning his life into a shining statue, inaccessible to entropy.

advice-d4b601abefd58af4eeb91122.title: Attuning Intellectual Harmony
advice-d4b601abefd58af4eeb91122.body: Your state should be “Dorian” - courageous, reserved and noble. A conscious person understands: any emotional licentiousness is a false note that destroys his personal cosmos. Treat your thoughts like the sounds of a lyre. If your mind is “disturbed” by everyday affects, you are not able to perceive the “voice from above.” Your task is to “tune your inner lyre to the Musician’s intention,” achieving such purity of tone that external circumstances can no longer cause you to rattle.

advice-0863faf70cd70959edf6eaf5.title: Aesthetic fixation of the role
advice-0863faf70cd70959edf6eaf5.body: Consider your destiny as the plot of a drama in which you are the leading actor. Plotinus pointed out that “in world drama, Nus is the author, and people are the artists.” Your dignity lies in the flawless performance of your role, whatever it may be in the overall hierarchy. If you resist the rhythm of events, you become a "bad dancer" who interferes with the whole choir. Learn to see the beauty in necessity and “accompany with your thoughts what is happening,” turning your every action into an element of a “divinely inspired dance.”

advice-3756c4cb96eb0c3d380fedd2.title: Cutting off sound debris
advice-3756c4cb96eb0c3d380fedd2.body: The space of your life must be airtight from the miasma and noise of the masses. Modern society produces an endless cacophony that seeks to drown out the “music of the spheres.” A conscious person ignores trends, vulgar tunes and empty talk of the crowd. Remember the covenant: “silence alone can name God.” Cultivate within yourself “noble silence,” which is the necessary background so that your Nous (Mind) can perceive the subtlest vibrations of the eternal Logos.

advice-60f6c62d612e7706a9955fd5.title: Synchronization with the rhythm of the Whole
advice-60f6c62d612e7706a9955fd5.body: Your activity should be “symphonic”. Stop acting chaotically or under the influence of random impulses. Every decision, business move or act of creativity must be inscribed in the “golden chain” of expediency. Anyone who lives in the rhythm of the Cosmos acquires “tonic power”, before which any Chaos is powerless. Power belongs to the one whose voice sounds in unison with the “song of the stars,” turning earthly existence into a continuous liturgy of presence.

advice-0120da34f20e4c53f216ac4c.title: Radical unmasking
advice-0120da34f20e4c53f216ac4c.body: Stop identifying with your “personal history”, social achievements and accumulated experiences. A conscious person understands: all these forms are only temporary clothes of the soul. Practice the state of the “naked and united” soul, as Plotinus instructed. Give up internal monologues where you confirm your status to yourself. In the presence of the highest Logos, your biography is just a pile of old rags. True dignity begins where “human affairs” end.

advice-26cd6210b2bb804c1a546974.title: Transition to intellectual dryness
advice-26cd6210b2bb804c1a546974.body: Your thinking should become sharp and simple, like a ray of light. Get rid of the emotional rattling and complexity generated by Chaos. Remember: “the soul sees the truth only when it is naked.” In everyday life and business, strive for conciseness and accuracy. Any “complication” is a sign of “drunk ignorance” and loss of focus. Your task is to achieve such a density of Nous (Mind) at which you will not need evidence and reasoning, for you will have a “direct grasp” of the essence of things.

advice-0f517b2351373866331c4e19.title: The Practice of the Sunlike Eye
advice-0f517b2351373866331c4e19.body: Learn to look at the world not as a consumer, but as a participant in divine contemplation. When you look at something worthy, don't try to "understand" or "analyze" it. Instead, “jump” into the very essence of the object, reaching a state where “there are no longer two.” This requires a volitional stop to the discursive mind. At moments of highest tension of will, fix the point of absolute silence. This “inner peace in motion” is a sign of participation in the One.

advice-46a3e81598f796a1cf3c3293.title: Sealing the Inner Sanctum
advice-46a3e81598f796a1cf3c3293.body: Treat your moments of highest concentration as the entrance to Aditon. Don't let the miasma of popular culture and the noise of the crowd touch this state. The conscious man guards his simplicity as the highest imperial treasure. Any external influence that causes you to "multiply" and "disperse" must be cut off by the sword of Reason. One who has mastered the art of simplification dictates reality from a point of absolute singularity, becoming invincible to entropy.
